description: Replying to @Broma Bakery Screaming. Crying. Throwing UP. The long awaited recipe is HERE! My take on the perfect Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookie 🫶🏼 Hope you guys enjoy as much as I do!!!!  ~ 18 tbsp of butter (browned)  3/4 cup granulated sugar  1 cup dark brown sugar  2 eggs 1 tablespoon vanilla bean paste 3 cups AP flour 2 teaspoons baking soda 1 teaspoon salt 1 cup semi sweet chocolate chunks 1 cup dark chocolate chunks  *flakey salt optional for topping  1.) In a saucepan, brown 18 tbsps (2 sticks + 2 tbsps) for about 5 minutes. Continuously whisk until the butter foams and turns a golden brown color. Remove from heat to cool for about 20 minutes.  2.) In a separate bowl, mix flour, baking soda, and salt until fully combined. Set aside 3.) After cooling the brown butter, add to a bowl along with granulated sugar & dark brown sugar. Mix until fully combined. Add in the vanilla bean paste (extract is ok too) and 2 eggs. Mix vigorously until it all comes together and starts to a turn a lighter brown color.  4.) Add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture and mix until JUST combined. Do not over mix!  5.) Add your chocolate chunks (chips are fine too) and scoop into 2.5OZ logs. It is important that you form them into logs instead of balls so that they are standing tall. This ensures that they will spread less and be thicker.  6.) Freeze for atleast 3 hours or overnight.  7.) Line baking sheet with parchment paper and bake at 350 degrees for 15-17 minutes rotating the tray halfway through to get even coloring. Top with flakey salt & enjoy! 🤍  • • • • • #bakingtiktok #sourdough #bakingrecipe #pastry #BakeWithMe #cookiedough #baketok #bananabread #chocolatechipcookies #cookierecipe #brownie #cake #inagarten #bromabakery #fyp #foryou #brownies #chocolatechipcookies #brownbutter #baker ‎#سنگت_ویڈیو_وائرل_کریسو_آپ_ہیں🥀🌼🙈✨🎇 #cookie #cookies
